prompt: I already submitted the invoices; do I still need to file an income tax return?
answer:
### Issue Presented
You are still required to file an income tax return even if you have submitted invoices. Under Section 23 of the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC), the filing of a tax return is mandatory for all taxpayers, regardless of whether they have generated income or submitted invoices during the taxable year. 

The income tax return serves as a formal declaration of your taxable income and is essential for the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) to assess your tax liability accurately. Failure to file the return can result in penalties and interest on any taxes due. 

In summary, ensure that you file your income tax return on or before the deadline to comply with tax regulations.
